summary: This bill codifies four May 2025 executive orders on nuclear energy by giving them the force of law, covering DOE reactor testing reform, deployment of advanced reactors for national security, NRC reorganization, and revitalization of the nuclear industrial base.

scores.thoughts: The bill codifies EOs directing reforms at DOE and NRC to accelerate nuclear reactor testing and deployment. These actions imply federal resources and agency activity that would typically require or expand government expenditures on nuclear infrastructure and oversight, even if no specific appropriations are authorized in the text. This produces a modest negative score.

One of the codified EOs is explicitly titled 'Deploying Advanced Nuclear Reactor Technologies for National Security,' directly linking nuclear development to defense objectives. This constitutes a clear, positive engagement with military and defense priorities.

The bill seeks to reform the NRC and DOE processes to accelerate advanced nuclear deployment. This regulatory streamlining limits environmental and safety regulations in the nuclear sector, aligning with the positive end of the scale even though nuclear power itself has climate benefits.
